headline: Public hearing on Haffner's Way Definitive Subdivision Plan covering 40 Sargent Street, 46 Millett Street, 10 Gale Road, 18 Gale Road, and 131R Gloucester Avenue.
summary: The Planning Board will hold a public hearing on Energy North Incorporated's application for the Haffner's Way Definitive Subdivision Plan. The board will also review proposed zoning amendments on multi-family dwelling dimensions and the Watershed Protection Overlay District.

# CITY OF GLOUCESTER
## PLANNING BOARD
**Kyrouz Auditorium, City Hall**
**9 Dale Avenue, Gloucester, MA 01930**
**October 1, 2026 – 5:00PM**

[https://gloucester-ma-gov.zoom.us/j/88223166315](https://gloucester-ma-gov.zoom.us/j/88223166315)

**Richard Noonan, Chair**

Persons who wish to view the meeting can join at: https://gloucester-ma-gov.zoom.us/j/88223166315
Or by Phone by dialing +19292056099 or +13017158592 Meeting ID: 88223166315
Please visit https://gloucester-ma.gov/1077/Remote-Public-Meetings for instructions and guidance on how to join the meeting remotely.

### BUSINESS

1. Call to Order
2. Introduction of Planning Board Members and Staff
3. Forum Invitation "The Power of Arts and Culture Planning" October 6, 2026 6PM in the Kyrouz Auditorium, City Hall - Miranda Hynes, Arts and Culture Coordinator

### Public Hearing

In accordance with the provisions of Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 41, § 81T, the Planning Board to consider an application submitted by Energy North Incorporated for approval of a Definitive Subdivision Plan entitled "Haffner's Way Definitive Subdivision Plan." located at **40 Sargent Street, 46 Millett Street, 10 Gale Road, 18 Gale Road, and 131R Gloucester Avenue** (Assessor's Map 32, Lots 18 and 22; Map 33, Lot 3; and Map 43, Lots 1 and 2).

### Other Business

1. Proposed Amendment to Section 3.2.2 Dimensional Requirements for Multi-family Dwellings and Their Accessory Uses (other than signs)
2. Proposed Amendments to Section 5.10 Watershed Protect Overlay District
3. Approval of Minutes of September 17, 2026
4. Matters not reasonably anticipated prior to the noticing of the meeting.
5. Adjournment

*The next regular meeting of the Planning Board will be held on October 15, 2026*
